eval_set_reuse_statement: The already-opened R2-10 EVAL set (experiments/R2-09-prediction-benchmark/eval_manifest.json, EVAL_LOCKED but EVAL_OPENED for R2-10 purposes) MUST NOT be used as the BRIDGE holdout, for BRIDGE policy development, or for BRIDGE policy selection. A brand-new prospective corpus is required.

design_decision.label: DESIGN_DECISION_NOT_STATISTICALLY_POWERED
design_decision.choice: Minimal balanced held-out design mirroring R2-09B's own: 4 new BRIDGE workload specifications = 1 held-out instance per nominal category (coding, reasoning, summarization, instruction), 1 deterministic capture each = 4 primary BRIDGE capture cells.
design_decision.confirmatory_scope: Primary confirmatory claims limited to these four frozen held-out instances. A single instance does not establish generalization across an entire workload family/category.
design_decision.rationale: Mirrors the already-accepted R2-09B/R2-10 minimal-design discipline; no sample size invented or expanded post hoc.

prompt_specification_requirement: BRIDGE prompt specifications must be authored and frozen (hashed) BEFORE any capture, and MUST NOT be copied from any prior DEV or EVAL prompt text used in R2-09A/R2-09B/R2-10. New prompts only.

model_identity.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M
model_identity.status: MUST_MATCH_FROZEN_RESEARCH2_PROTOCOL_AT_ACQUISITION; record actual artifact path/SHA in the acquisition manifest -- same model identity already used throughout Research 2, never substituted.

deterministic_capture_conditions.seed_policy: Record explicit acquisition seed per cell; deterministic greedy decoding, same convention as R2-09B's eval_manifest.json.deterministic_capture_conditions.
deterministic_capture_conditions.context_limits: Record actual context/runtime limits in the acquisition manifest; must be consistent across a cell comparison unless explicitly versioned.
deterministic_capture_conditions.expert_memory_capture_budget_relevance: Expert-memory budget (1.5/4/8 GiB) is a REPLAY/evaluation parameter applied after capture, not a capture-time constraint; capture-time budget/configuration must still be recorded and consistent with the Research2 trace schema/protocol, identical in spirit to eval_manifest.json's own note.

trace_schema_and_validation.trace_schema: Research2 R2Trace/routing trace schema used by the canonical pipeline (or an explicitly versioned compatible schema)
validation_requirements: trace parses and normalizes via argine.research2.r2_01.trace_contract.normalize/reconcile, identical to every prior Research2 corpus
SHA256 recorded for trace and workload spec
replay contract compatibility checked before any cell is treated as valid
cardinality-availability fail-safe (trace.meta.top_k matches every observed per-event cardinality) re-checked exactly as CARDINALITY-AVAILABILITY-AUDIT-001 already established for R2-10

capture_seal_open_state_machine.transition_rule: Each transition is recorded as a NEW additive provenance/state-record JSON file (never an in-place mutation of a frozen file), mirroring the R2-09B/R2-10 EVAL_* state-machine convention established in experiments/R2-10-working-set-predictor/PHASE3C-EVAL-OPENED.json and PHASE3L-FINAL-CLOSURE-RECORD.json.
capture_seal_open_state_machine.phase_0_scope: Phase 0 freezes this contract and state machine. It does NOT execute BRIDGE_ACQUISITION_PLANNED's capture step and does NOT create any trace file. Capture is a future, separately-authorized action.
